content.short: Indodax is Indonesia's largest crypto exchange, licensed by the country's financial regulator OJK.
content.description: Indodax is Indonesia's largest crypto asset exchange, operating since 2014 with more than 10 million registered members and over 500 listed assets. It is licensed and supervised by Indonesia's Financial Services Authority (OJK). Blockscout's World Chain app marketplace lists Indodax.
content.meta: Indodax is Indonesia's largest, OJK-licensed crypto exchange, listed in the World Chain app directory.
